title: 大闹天宫
subtitle: 云海里的一场追逐游戏
origin: 《西游记》第四至七回（低龄改编）

moral.zh: 遇到不公平要勇敢说出来，也要尊重约定；本领越大，责任也越大。
moral.en: Speak up when something feels unfair, but respect agreements too. Greater ability brings greater responsibility.

pages.en: Wukong cared for the horses wonderfully, but when he learned his post was considered minor, he felt that no one had taken him seriously.
